items.title: First-time setup
items.note: Create the owner account on first launch. No screenshot yet: not seen on screen.

items.title: Lock screen
items.note: Pick a name, then type a PIN (cashier) or password. No screenshot yet: not seen on screen.

items.title: Billing register
items.note: Scan or type a barcode, lines left, total and payment right, manager approval for a big discount, saved bill with Print and New bill. No screenshot yet: not seen on screen.

items.title: Stock entry (Size x Color grid)
items.note: Owner enters a purchase in a Size x Color grid and prints hangtags. No screenshot yet: not seen on screen.

items.title: Returns
items.note: Scan a sold garment, back in stock or damaged, refund by cash, UPI, card, credit note or exchange; manager approval after 7 days; credit note slip. No screenshot yet: not seen on screen.

items.title: Blind shift close
items.note: Open a shift by counting the drawer, blind close (no expected amount shown), forced close of an earlier day, owner list of closes. No screenshot yet: not seen on screen.

items.title: Daily report
items.note: One India day at a time: sales, money by mode, refunds, cash count per shift, top styles, profit. No screenshot yet: not seen on screen.

items.title: Backups and restore
items.note: Choose the USB drive and a second folder, Back up now, status and failures, restore from a backup (owner's password and RESTORE typed), first-launch restore on a new computer. No screenshot yet: not seen on screen.

items.title: Recovery key
items.note: Shown once to the owner or manager after first sign-in; they type the last group back. No screenshot yet: not seen on screen.
